title: Pure Flamvell
summary: Flamvell is a FIRE Pyro/Spellcaster/Dragon Synchro archetype where almost every monster has exactly 200 DEF. When Flamvell Firedog destroys an opponent's monster by battle, it summons Flamvell Magician from the Deck for an instant Level 8 Synchro, while Rekindling revives up to 5 FIRE monsters with 200 DEF simultaneously for explosive Synchro climbs and Flamvell Counter omni-Spell/Trap negation.

allow.Bonfire: Searches any Level 4 or lower Pyro monster from your Deck (searching Flamvell Firedog, Neo Flamvell Lady, Neo Flamvell Origin, or Flamvell Baby; Limited to 1 in TCG).
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends a 200 DEF Flamvell monster to the GY to fuel Rekindling and Flamvell Counter (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Ancient Flamvell Deity: Signature Level 7 FIRE Pyro Synchro boss (1 Flamvell Tuner + 1+ FIRE non-Tuners).
allow.Crimson Blader: Level 8 FIRE Synchro made with Flamvell Firedog + Flamvell Magician that locks the opponent out of summoning Level 5 or higher monsters.
allow.T.G. Hyper Librarian: Level 5 Synchro that draws 1 card for every Synchro Summon performed after resolving Rekindling (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Formula Synchron: Level 2 Synchro Tuner made with Flamvell Baby + Level 1 that draws 1 card on Summon.

main: Flamvell Firedog
Signature Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior (1900 ATK / 200 DEF) that Special Summons any FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF directly from your Deck whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Flamvell Magician
Level 4 FIRE Spellcaster Tuner (1400 ATK / 200 DEF) summoned from the Deck by Flamvell Firedog for an instant Level 8 Synchro Summon, and valid target for Rekindling.
Neo Flamvell Lady

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1600 ATK / 200 DEF) that sends 1 FIRE monster from hand to GY as a Quick Effect to banish a card from the opponent's GY, and sends a FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF from Deck to GY if a card is banished from their GY!
Neo Flamvell Origin
Level 2 FIRE Pyro Tuner (500 ATK / 200 DEF) that Special Summons itself from the hand if you control a Flamvell monster and your opponent has 3 or fewer cards in their GY.
Flamvell Poun
Level 1 FIRE Pyro (200 ATK / 200 DEF) that adds ANY monster with 200 DEF from your Deck to your hand when destroyed by battle and sent to the GY.
Flamvell Archer
Level 3 FIRE Pyro Tuner (1000 ATK / 200 DEF) that tributes 1 face-up Pyro monster you control to boost all Flamvell monsters on the field by 800 ATK.
Flamvell Baby
Level 1 FIRE Pyro Tuner (800 ATK / 200 DEF) that can be discarded from the hand to give a FIRE monster 400 ATK and load the GY for Rekindling.
Flamvell Guard
Level 1 FIRE Dragon Normal Tuner (100 ATK / 2000 DEF) that provides Level 1 Tuner access.
Rekindling
Iconic Spell that Special Summons as many FIRE monsters with 200 DEF as possible from your GY (reviving up to 5 Flamvell Tuners and non-Tuners at once!).
Flamvell Counter
Signature Counter Trap that banishes 1 FIRE monster with 200 DEF from your GY to negate the activation of ANY Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.
Bonfire
Limited to 1 in TCG: adds any Level 4 or lower Pyro monster (Neo Flamvell Lady or Neo Flamvell Origin) from your Deck to your hand.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: dumps a 200 DEF Flamvell monster to the GY to turn on Rekindling and Flamvell Counter.
extra: Signature Level 7 FIRE Pyro Synchro boss (1 Flamvell Tuner + 1+ FIRE non-Tuners) that banishes cards from the opponent's GY up to the number of cards in their hand on Synchro Summon and gains 200 ATK for each banished card.
Signature Level 6 FIRE Pyro Synchro that inflicts piercing battle damage and permanently gains 300 ATK every time it inflicts battle damage to the opponent.
Level 8 FIRE Synchro made with Firedog + Magician that locks down Level 5+ summons.
Limited to 1 in TCG: Level 5 Synchro that draws cards repeatedly when Synchro climbing off Rekindling.
Level 2 Synchro Tuner that draws 1 card on Summon.
